import pandas as pd

don = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
ct = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv')

print("Status counts in March 2026:")
m = don[don['Ngày'].str.startswith('2026-03')]
print(m['Tình trạng'].value_counts())

# Revenue = orders not cancelled, not returned (completed + shipping)
kept = ['completed', 'shipping']
order_ids = set(m[m['Tình trạng'].isin(kept)]['Mã chứng từ'])
print("orders kept:", len(order_ids))

amt = ct[ct['Mã đơn hàng'].isin(order_ids)]['Amount']
total = amt.sum()
print("Revenue March 2026:", total)
